name: CMN Substrate
synopsis: The shared Rust library for CMN — data models, cryptographic verification, tree hashing, URI parsing, and JSON-schema validation used by Hypha and Synapse.
intent: Provide the common foundation shared between Hypha (client) and Synapse (indexer): spore/mycelium data models, Ed25519 signature verification, BLAKE3 content hashing, CMN URI parsing, and spore.core.json schema validation
mutations: Add Manifest and decode_manifest to decode a payload as either a spore or a mycelium and verify its signatures, and add parse_json_no_duplicates to reject duplicate JSON keys
Tighten validation: reject uppercase and weak (all-zero) keys when recovering a public key from a hub subdomain, restrict URL schemes and hosts, and verify the declared size when extracting archives
Embed the updated spore-core schema allowing absorbed_from to be authored, and extend schema validation
Add signed capsule and key rotation conformance vectors and run them in the conformance tests
Move to Rust edition 2024 and upgrade dependencies (agent-first-slug 0.9, jsonschema 0.61, zstd 0.14, unicase 2.10)

bonds.reason: Implements core CMN data structures and verification logic per the specification
